svg.aria-label: Two panels. Today: the lab's host wires workforce by hand with a circular callback and casts; five files sit in workforce/flows, among them the lab's own projects, pins and dismissals; a 1,642-line adapter watches, caches and assembles rows over sessions made only to read; and a session works in a workforce project. After: the host lists three kits, workforce, harnesses and the app's own; the app kit holds pins, dismissals, the repositories flow, two worker settings and a run source; src/lab.ts is a few hooks over the kit packages' views plus the app's thread renderer; and a session works in a repository the workspace host registered, with no workforce project.
